hypotheses.N1_boundary_changes_enter_address_span: The full four-address span captures at least twice the state-change energy of median random four-spaces on every corpus.
hypotheses.N2_address_span_captures_boundary_mlp_wr: The exact MLP response to address-projected boundary changes has write-delta R-squared at least 0.50 on every corpus.
hypotheses.N3_address_span_predicts_boundary_mlp_lo: Address-projected exact MLP responses leave at most 25% relative prediction KL on every corpus.
hypotheses.N4_shared_address_backbone_is_sufficient: The leading principal direction of the four native addresses achieves at least 75% of the full address-span write R-squared on every corpus.
hypotheses.N5_address_span_beats_unsupervised_state: The address span has higher write R-squared than the top-four natural-state PCA space on every corpus.
hypotheses.N6_supervised_boundary_pca_is_an_upper_b: The FineWeb-trained boundary-delta PCA space has higher write R-squared than the address span on every corpus.
hypotheses.N7_layer11_mlp_path_is_material_to_full_: The isolated Layer-11 MLP-path KL is at least 10% of full-token-edit KL on every corpus.
hypotheses.N8_address_advantage_transfers_ood: Address-span write R-squared is positive and exceeds median random controls on WikiText and TinyStories.
